overview_description.description:
A smart way to get a visa card within minutes. With Uni, pay flexibly in 3 parts over 3 months for no extra costs. Apply now and get the digital card on the Uni app. We’re currently lifetime free for early users. 


Uni Cards was established on October, 2020 by Nitin Gupta in Bangalore, Karnataka.
